description: Source code for diff-delta.c, a C implementation for generating binary deltas between buffers, inspired by LibXDiff, used in Git for delta compression.

methods.name: create_delta_index
methods.description: Creates an index for delta computation from a buffer, using Rabin fingerprinting and hash buckets.

methods.name: free_delta_index
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for a delta index.

methods.name: sizeof_delta_index
methods.description: Returns the size in bytes of a delta index.

methods.name: create_delta
methods.description: Generates a delta between a reference buffer and a target buffer, returning the delta data and its size.
